theme.description: Modern, premium, extremely simple. Earthy undertones reflecting Dharamshala's mountains combined with crisp SaaS dashboard utility to establish a high-trust, premium hospitality environment.

layouts.dashboard: Sidebar on the left (w-64 on desktop, hidden/drawer on mobile), top header for context/actions, main content area with spacious padding (p-6 or p-8). Apply The 'Bento' Grid Protocol for the main overview.
layouts.mobile_first: For Housekeeping/Maintenance: Strictly no sidebar. Bottom navigation or simple top app bar. Big touch targets (min 48px height), large legible text.
layouts.calendar_grid: Room rows, Date columns. Sticky first column (Rooms) and first row (Dates). Sub-grid alignment, 1px border on cells. Dense packing to allow high visibility of bookings across days.

components.cards: Flat, 1px subtle border, rounded-2xl, no drop shadow by default. On hover, translate-y-[-2px] and subtle shadow. Generous internal padding (p-6 to p-8).
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or slightly rounded (rounded-lg) with modern hover state. Avoid generic blue. Use Primary (Sage Green) for main actions.
components.badges: Used for statuses. Rounded-full, soft backgrounds with dark text, font-medium.
components.sidebar: Subtle glassmorphism or solid background with 1px right border. Active state is highly visible with a left border highlight and muted background.
components.forms: Use Shadcn customized inputs. Clean labels, distinct focus rings with high contrast.
components.tables: Sparingly used outside of detailed logs. For bookings, prefer the calendar grid or distinct list cards over dense unformatted tables.

spacing: Use Generous Spacing Philosophy. p-6 to p-8 for major containers. gap-6 or gap-8 between widgets. Prevent text collision by padding.

motion.hover: Opacity changes for text, subtle Y-axis transforms for cards.
motion.click: Scale down to 0.98 on active using framer-motion or CSS active state.
motion.transitions: Add 'transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out' or 'transition-transform' for interactive elements. EXCLUDE 'all' from transitions.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for sticky headers and modals (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 in light, bg-black/60 in dark). 1px delicate inner stroke mandatory. NEVER fully transparent.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the grid subtly where data density is high (Calendar, Analytics).
visual_enhancers.typography: High contrast tracking-tight for headings (text-3xl to text-5xl max). tracking-wider uppercase for overlines/labels.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA standards or WCAG AA minimum. Explicitly set text color on hover states.
accessibility.focus: Focus rings must have higher contrast than default.
accessibility.testid: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: NOTE: You are working with .js / .jsx files, NOT TypeScript. Do not create .tsx files.
Install `@phosphor-icons/react` or use `lucide-react` for a premium, dense dashboard aesthetic.
Include Google Fonts: 'Outfit' (for headings) and 'Manrope' (for body) in index.html, then set them up in tailwind config.
Update `index.css` with the exact HSL variables provided in `theme.colors`.
Design a Role-based Navigation sidebar that updates items dynamically based on the current user role.
Housekeeping and Maintenance views must be heavily restricted and mobile-first. Do not display complex charts to them; show task cards with big actionable 'Complete' buttons.
Integrate Recharts for the Analytics dashboard to show occupancy, revenue, etc. Keep the charts simple, avoiding gridlines overload.
Render all currency elements with '₹' (INR) and align times to 'IST'.
Use data-testid on all key interactive elements for testing (e.g. data-testid='sidebar-bookings-link').
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for floating elements. NEVER USE FULLY TRANSPARENT BACKGROUNDS over content.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). This breaks transforms. Add transitions for specific properties (colors, transform).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc. for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
ALWAYS use the provided image URLs for placeholders, avatars, and property backgrounds. DO NOT use generic placeholder services.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
